{"implementation":"def solve(case):
    threshold = case["threshold"]
    calls = case["calls"]
    accepted = []
    norm_weights = []
    stronger = []
    order = []
    for call in calls:
        call_id = call["call_id"]
        order.append(call_id)
        gain = call["loss_without_call"] - call["loss_with_call"]
        tokens = call["prediction_tokens"]
        denominator = tokens if tokens >= 1 else 1
        norm_gain = gain / denominator
        gain_rounded = round(gain, 6)
        norm_rounded = round(norm_gain, 6)
        stronger.append(gain_rounded)
        norm_weights.append(norm_rounded)
        if call["parseable"] and norm_gain >= threshold:
            accepted.append(call_id)
    result = {
        "accepted_ids": accepted,
        "normalized_weights": norm_weights,
        "stronger_counterfactual": stronger,
        "inclusive_threshold": threshold,
        "stable_order": order
    }
    return result"}
